decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.859. Series context: trend strength 0.9912 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.361); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.716.
